environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'data-plane' running with default service account. Pod has IMDSv1 access (HttpTokens: optional on node launch template). No network policies applied. The gRPC port 50051 is exposed via a Kubernetes Service of type ClusterIP accessible from any pod in the cluster. The Lambda function URL (ENRICHMENT_SERVICE_URL) is configured with AuthType: NONE for development convenience.
